title: notopleura discolor
intro: Notopleura discolor, commonly known as "Palo Amarillo", is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including treating digestive issues, fever reduction, and inflammation. The health benefits of Notopleura discolor include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiparasitic effects, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids such as notopteran, notopleurin, and notopluridine, among others.
